message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"coders/pdb.c","function":"ReadPDBImage","line":344,"var":"image_info->filename / blob input","code":"OpenBlob(image_info,image,ReadBinaryBlobMode,exception)","note":"Attacker-controlled PDB bytes are opened as the input blob for parsing."},
{"step":2,"file":"coders/pdb.c","function":"ReadPDBImage","line":344,"var":"pdb_image.version","code":"pdb_image.version=ReadBlobByte(image);","note":"The file selects version 0 or 1, which controls whether raw bytes or RLE are decoded into the pixel buffer."},
{"step":3,"file":"coders/pdb.c","function":"ReadPDBImage","line":344,"var":"pdb_image.type","code":"pdb_image.type=ReadBlobByte(image);","note":"The file selects 1-, 2-, or 4-bit grayscale packing, which determines how many bytes are consumed per scanline."},
{"step":4,"file":"coders/pdb.c","function":"ReadPDBImage","line":344,"var":"pdb_image.width / pdb_image.height","code":"pdb_image.width=ReadBlobMSBShort(image); pdb_image.height=ReadBlobMSBShort(image);","note":"The attacker controls the image dimensions, which determine how much pixel cache is allocated and how many scanline bytes are later exported."},
{"step":5,"file":"coders/pdb.c","function":"ReadPDBImage","line":344,"var":"packets / pixels","code":"packets=MagickArraySize(...); pixels=MagickAllocateMemory(...);","note":"A packed pixel buffer is allocated, but it is not initialized before decoding writes only the bytes present in the file."},
{"step":6,"file":"coders/pdb.c","function":"ReadPDBImage","line":344,"var":"p","code":"p=pixels;","note":"The decoder later walks the packed buffer sequentially while expanding pixels into the image cache."},
{"step":7,"file":"coders/pdb.c","function":"ReadPDBImage","line":344,"var":"*q / indexes[x]","code":"*q++=image->colormap[index]; indexes[x]=index;","note":"The image cache is populated from the packed buffer, but the scanline width is rounded up to 16 pixels, leaving padding bytes potentially untouched."},
{"step":8,"file":"coders/pdb.c","function":"WritePDBImage","line":809,"var":"scanline[x*packet_size]","code":"ExportImagePixelArea(image,GrayQuantum,image->depth,scanline,0,0);","note":"When the image is written back out, the encoder exports every scanline byte, including any padding-derived bytes from the cache."},
{"step":9,"file":"coders/pdb.c","function":"WritePDBImage","line":809,"var":"buffer[literal+repeat]","code":"buffer[literal+repeat]|=(0xff-scanline[x*packet_size]) >> (8-bits_per_pixel) << bits*bits_per_pixel;","note":"Reading an uninitialized scanline byte here triggers the use-of-uninitialized-value sink described by the vulnerability."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.txt /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
